0 grammar ::= remember stmtseq
1 grammar ::= GRAMEXPR optexpr
2 grammar ::= GRAMBLOCK block
3 grammar ::= GRAMBARESTMT barestmt
4 grammar ::= GRAMFULLSTMT fullstmt
5 grammar ::= GRAMSTMTSEQ stmtseq
6 grammar ::= GRAMSUBSIGNATURE subsigguts
7 bare_statement_block ::= block cont
8 bare_statement_expression ::= sideff PERLY_SEMICOLON
9 bare_statement_null ::= PERLY_SEMICOLON
10 bare_statement_utilize ::= KW_USE_or_NO startsub BAREWORD optlistexpr PERLY_SEMICOLON
11 block ::= PERLY_BRACE_OPEN remember stmtseq PERLY_BRACE_CLOSE
12 empty ::=
13 remember ::=
14 stmtseq ::= empty
15 stmtseq ::= stmtseq fullstmt
16 fullstmt ::= barestmt
17 barestmt ::= bare_statement_block
18 barestmt ::= bare_statement_expression
19 barestmt ::= bare_statement_null
20 barestmt ::= bare_statement_utilize
21 sideff ::= expr
22 cont ::= empty
23 startsub ::=
24 optsiglist ::= empty
25 subsigguts ::= optsiglist
26 expr ::= listexpr
27 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA
28 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA term
29 listexpr ::= term
30 termbinop ::= term ASSIGNOP term
31 termbinop ::= term ADDOP term
32 termbinop ::= termrelop
33 termbinop ::= termeqop
34 termrelop ::= relopchain
35 termrelop ::= term NCRELOP term
36 termrelop ::= term PLUGIN_REL_OP term
37 relopchain ::= term CHRELOP term
38 relopchain ::= relopchain CHRELOP term
39 termeqop ::= eqopchain
40 termeqop ::= term NCEQOP term
41 eqopchain ::= term CHEQOP term
42 eqopchain ::= eqopchain CHEQOP term
43 termunop ::= PERLY_MINUS term
44 termunop ::= PERLY_PLUS term
45 termunop ::= PERLY_EXCLAMATION_MARK term
46 termunop ::= PERLY_TILDE term
47 termunop ::= term POSTINC
48 termunop ::= term POSTDEC
49 termunop ::= term POSTJOIN
50 termunop ::= PREINC term
51 termunop ::= PREDEC term
52 term ::= termbinop
53 term ::= termunop
54 term ::= scalar
55 term ::= star
56 term ::= hsh
57 term ::= ary
58 term ::= arylen
59 term ::= THING
60 term ::= amper
61 optlistexpr ::= empty
62 optlistexpr ::= listexpr
63 optexpr ::= empty
64 optexpr ::= expr
65 amper ::= PERLY_AMPERSAND BAREWORD
66 scalar ::= PERLY_DOLLAR
67 ary ::= PERLY_SNAIL
68 hsh ::= PERLY_PERCENT_SIGN
69 arylen ::= DOLSHARP
70 star ::= PERLY_STAR BAREWORD
